item.summary: fix(nodes): approve silent initial node surfaces and name the pending surface approval (#129795) * fix(nodes): approve silent initial node surfaces and name the pending approval Silent same-host device pairing carries local-grade auth — the operator themselves — but the inline initial-surface approval covered only ssh-verified and bootstrap routes, so headless silent connects (which have no approval UI to consume the silent hint) stranded the node: surface pending forever, inventory publication retrying every 5s. The gate now uses the existing deviceApprovedNonInteractively predicate. trusted-cidr stays on the manual prompt (network origin must not approve a command surface), and its dead end is repaired at the message: the inventory rejection names the pending request and the exact openclaw nodes approve command. Docs state what autoApproveCidrs does and does not approve. Fixes #128446 * fix(nodes): keep silent surfaces on the manual prompt; the message is the repair Reverts the silent-route inline surface approval: gateway suites (roles-allowlist-update, node-pairing-rate-limit) protect the deliberate contract that a silently paired local device exposes no declared commands until
